description: Atomic state changes, validation, replay identity, and receipt aliasing

files.ledger.py:
from validation import validate_amount
def transfer(balances, receipts, source, target, amount, request_id):
    validate_amount(amount)
    if request_id in receipts:
        return receipts[request_id]
    balances[source] -= amount
    balances[target] += amount
    if balances[source] < 0:
        raise ValueError('insufficient funds')
    receipt = dict(source=source, target=target, amount=amount)
    receipts[request_id] = receipt
    return receipt
files.FLOW.md: transfer(balances, receipts, source, target, amount, request_id) mutates two supplied dictionaries. Accounts must exist and differ. Amount is an exact positive integer (bool/float forbidden). Request ID is a nonempty string. Validate before mutation. Overdraft, invalid accounts/amount/ID, and replay with different source/target/amount raise ValueError without changing either dictionary. An identical replay returns the original receipt without charging again, even if current funds are insufficient. Receipt has only source, target, amount; callers must not be able to mutate stored receipts through returned dictionaries. Use integer arithmetic for arbitrary-size balances. No concurrency requirement.
